item.description:
• The Try again button on the welcome screen works, and looks like it. Asking Kit to pick up reading your history where it stopped did start it, every time, but the card reporting it vanished the moment you clicked, so there was no way to tell. It now turns into the live reading panel straight away.
  • And if that does not start, Kit says so. A refused or unreachable request used to look exactly like a working one: nothing happened either way, and you were left to guess whether the button had done anything.
